about: Plugins that have a home of their own. `clearsky add <name>` adds one from here, at the version pinned below. Each folder next to this file is that plugin's code, kept here until its repo exists; scripts/split-plugins.mjs turns a folder into a repo. `retired` names plugins that are gone, and what to use instead.

retired.name: slack
retired.why: The token-based Slack plugin is retired: Slack (MCP) does the same mentions with a browser login and no token, and gives chats Slack to read too.
